name: dev-mentor
description: Learn to build features in your codebase, one focused step at a time.

interface.longDescription: Ten engineering mentoring skills, plus a shared style skill, that adapt to you, from vibe coder to principal engineer. Set your experience level, tone, pace, ADHD mode and how to build (write it yourself, copy explained code, let the AI write it, or plan a spec or OpenSpec change). Find where to start in a codebase, trace how code runs, build features step by step with your work checked, understand colleagues' PRs, compare designs, and turn plans into specs. Save several lessons, resume any of them, and export them as notes to Notion, Obsidian or Markdown. Mentor can watch PR comments and CI when your assistant supports it; the three-model debate needs three distinct models.
defaultPrompt: Use mentor to help me get started.
Help me build this feature one small step at a time. I'll write the code.
Walk me through this completed change and help me explain it to a colleague.
